purpose: Independent return, unit, and calendar-assumption audit of nine retained research packages

method.implementation: Python standard-library Decimal at precision 80; integer EPS growth and discount powers; price fractional power calculated as exp(ln(terminal/current)/years). Inputs loaded from retained evidence, comparisons from saved calculations, report displays separately normalized. No production model code called.

numeric_tolerance.rule: PASS when abs(saved - independently_recomputed) <= absolute + relative * abs(independently_recomputed). Exact integer/finite-decimal products are retained at audit precision. This tolerance accommodates saved approximately 40-significant-digit Decimal outputs without allowing material financial errors.
numeric_tolerance.display_rule: For report/index strings use half one unit in the last displayed decimal place after USD/billion/percent conversion, plus the numeric tolerance. Percent comparisons normalize by 0.01. Unlabeled original decimal return cells are numeric PASS but unit AMBIGUITY.

formulas.pe: price / historical_EPS if historical_EPS > 0; otherwise null
formulas.weighted_present_target_vs_price: weighted_PV / current_price - 1; a present-valuation comparison, NOT annualized as future CAGR

method.hash_binding: SHA256 of exact UTF-8 evidence.json and calculations.json binds numeric inputs and saved comparison dataset. Corrected report hashes bind current display observations; original report hashes plus captured failed/unit-ambiguous fields retain historical findings. Native audit.json and regenerated index audit-status receipts are deliberately not numeric inputs.

scope.verification_executed: Independent research recomputation and retained-report display comparison only. No tests, build, lint, formatter, quote fetch, or trading execution.

current_report_review.reason: Final report-tail edits changed report bytes after the initial proof was saved; current numeric displays were reviewed and independently recomputed before refreshing report hash bindings.
current_report_review.method: Read current report lines for all scenario prices/CAGRs/PVs, historical metrics, weighted PVs and repeated AMZN capitalization. Recompute from unchanged retained evidence using 80-digit Decimal, without production calculate/audit imports; compare extracted display values using documented display tolerance.
current_report_review.checks_reference: Each tickers.<ticker>.report_checks entry remains the freshly observed current display, source line, independent result, delta and tolerance; the fresh pass found no numeric or source-line changes. Source hashes now bind the final reviewed report bytes.

findings.corrected_report_observation: Observed original AMZN capitalization was wrong in two locations and META in one, each 1,000-fold too small; current owned report edits restore USD values. Original AAPL/NFLX CAGR fractions were numerically correct but not explicitly identified as decimals; corrected reports show percentages. These are reporting findings, not saved financial arithmetic failures.
findings.calendar_alignment: All nine retained evidence valuation objects lack valuation.timing. Five configured EPS growth steps and five assumed price holding/discount years are observed; actual dated price CAGR cannot be verified. Forward EPS is not universally an error: NFLX explicitly uses illustrative October2031 price exit with FY2032 forward EPS.
findings.missing_aggregate_reporting: Original/current report and captured index scope do not report weighted terminal price/CAGR-of-weighted-terminal or probability-weighted mean scenario CAGR. This audit computes and labels the two distinct diagnostics, without annualizing weighted present-value upside.
findings.interpretation_limit: All target/return diagnostics remain conditional on retained EPS/growth/multiple/probability/hurdle assumptions; arithmetic PASS is not economic normalization, forecast validation, source truth, fair value, investment approval, or a guarantee.
